column2: Not a whisky producer: the brand's own site (yakusun.com) frames the whole range as a blended "spirit drink" -- "a new Japanese-inspired recipe created by blending selected spirits with aged Japanese whisky" -- rather than whisky itself. Two of the three catalogue variants are explicit fruit flavours (Yuzu, Passion Fruit), and the site names no distillery, only a Yakuza-themed marketing story. A flavoured spirits/liqueur-adjacent brand, not a whisky producer.
